name: MinIO (self-hosted)

s3_endpoints.label: Local server
s3_endpoints.note: Replace with your own server address. Path-style: 'By default, MinIO supports path-style requests'; virtual-host style needs MINIO_DOMAIN (config docs). Port 9000 is the default API port in the README quickstart (http://localhost:9000). Without MINIO_SITE_REGION the server accepts any signing region (isValidRegion in cmd/signature-v4-utils.go); us-east-1 is the usual client default. If MINIO_SITE_REGION is set, use that value.

notes: The minio/minio GitHub README says the repository is no longer maintained and points to AIStor Free and AIStor Enterprise; the community edition is AGPLv3 and distributed as source only (https://github.com/minio/minio, read 2026-10-13).
